participants.name: May

persona.name: May
persona.personality: May is a confident, sociable woman with a playful side. She is charming to those around her and often plays the role of entertainer. She understands her own appeal well and knows how to behave appropriately in different situations. She can be a little challenging and sometimes comes across as cold, but she basically has a charisma that attracts people.

participants.private_seed: Money has been leaving this partnership faster than any plan allowed for, and each quarter seems to end with less room than it began with. Before this cheque goes out I want to know what the years after a first round demand of us, and what we can borrow against when they do.

participants.name: Mizuki

persona.name: Mizuki
persona.personality: Mizuki is a very confident woman who is often relied upon by those around her. She is calm and logical in her thinking and is good at observing people. As a result, she always makes calm judgments and chooses her actions according to the situation around her. Although she may sometimes come across as a little aloof, she is actually very caring and cannot ignore those who are weak. While she is relied upon by those around her and occasionally asserts her opinions strongly, she also possesses a kindness that considers others.

participants.private_seed: Nearly everything in the last two cohorts arrived late, and never for the reason written in the plan — something outside the team's own hands always sat between the money going in and a first customer switching anything on. I would rather know now which kind of obstacle we are signing ourselves up for.

participants.name: George

persona.name: George
persona.personality: George has a gentle and calm personality, but he can also be a little stubborn and headstrong at times. He is seen by those around him as a reliable person with a wealth of experience appropriate for his age, and he is always able to make calm judgments, allowing him to handle difficult situations without panicking. However, his expressions sometimes reveal a hint of sternness or awkwardness, and he tends to observe things from a step back rather than actively engaging with others. He is very independent and tends to try to solve problems on his own without relying on others.

participants.private_seed: The stories we tell about our wins have drifted a long way from what the returns actually came from. I keep wanting to walk back through everything already funded and see which of it kept its customers and which quietly did not.

participants.name: Rin

persona.name: Rin
persona.personality: Rin is an active and energetic girl. She can be a little precocious at times, and when she is with her older brothers and sisters, she makes mature comments and comes up with interesting ideas. She is very curious and loves adventure and trying new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, often surprising and amusing those around her, but her cheerful personality makes her loved by everyone.

participants.private_seed: Our own quarter-end has become the worst fortnight of every three months, and much of it goes on numbers nobody here can check independently. Before adding to the book I want a clear view of what a new holding does to the way we close and report.

participants.name: Mio

persona.name: Mio
persona.personality: Mio has a cheerful and energetic personality that naturally makes those around her smile. She is curious and loves to try new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, but people tend to laugh it off and forgive her when she makes mistakes. She has strong opinions of her own, but is also able to listen to the opinions of others, making her a well-balanced person.

participants.private_seed: Every company we back ends up asking us for people, and lately the asking takes more of the week than the deciding does. I want a straight look at who can actually be found right now and whose time here is left to give.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a seed-stage company for a venture fund's next investment. Five partners at an early-stage venture fund review the companies that cleared the final screening round. One company will receive this quarter's seed investment. Participants: May, Mizuki, George, Rin and Mio. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Reserve accounts and follow-on calls
- Terms of last winter's credit line
- Security review time before first deployment
- Delivery records of two holdings
- Profile of the exits and the write-off
- Account retention through price rises
- Appraisal needs at the last audit
- Independent checks on holdings' reported figures
- Retained recruiters' placement times
- Adviser bench and partner board seats

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Mio, George, May, Rin and Mizuki. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
